chunks: We have sent you as a benevolence to the creatures of the world.

key_terms.أَرْسَلْنَاكَ: We sent you (referring to the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: What is the universal significance of Prophet Muhammad's mission as a mercy to all worlds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted through the lens of the 'Fourteen Infallibles,' viewing the Prophet's mercy as extending through his progeny and the Imams who preserve and embody divine guidance. Historically, it refutes the notion of a tribal or exclusive mission, affirming that the Prophet's role as a mercy encompasses all creation, including humans and jinn, until the Day of Judgment. This universal scope reinforces the Shia belief in the continuity of divine mercy through the Ahl al-Bayt.
